title: BNCI 2014-004 Motor Imagery dataset
description: EEG recordings from 9 healthy, BCI-naive participants performing two-class motor imagery (left versus right hand), originally released as BCI Competition 2008 Graz data set B (BCI Competition IV dataset 2b). Each participant completed five sessions: two screening sessions without feedback and three sessions with smiley feedback. Data comprise three bipolar EEG channels (C3, Cz, C4) and three EOG channels sampled at 250 Hz.
methods_description: Participants performed kinesthetic motor imagery of left or right hand movements. Screening sessions (6 runs x 20 trials) used a fixation cross, beep and arrow cue followed by 4 s of imagery. Feedback sessions (4 runs x 40 trials) presented a smiley with continuous visual feedback during the cue period (3-7.5 s). EEG and EOG were recorded with g.tec amplifiers at 250 Hz, with a 0.5-100 Hz bandpass and 50 Hz notch filter. The EEG ground was at Fz, and the EOG channels were referenced to the left mastoid. Stimulus presentation used rtsBCI (MATLAB/Simulink).
